QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_31

question.text: The SEBI (AIF) Regulations 2012 'privately pooled investment vehicle' definition EXCLUDES:

answer.text: Mutual funds, collective investment schemes, family trusts/ESOP/holding companies, SPVs for securitisation, other regulators

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.1.1, SEBI AIF Regulations specifically exclude MFs, CIS, family trusts, ESOP, holding companies, SPVs, and funds under RBI/IRDAI. The Trap: Partial exclusions or full-inclusion miss SEBI's carve-outs. Cross-Exam Context: Foundational definition. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Walk clients through what's NOT an AIF to clarify classification confusion.
